facettes-dentaires-casablanca.metaTitle: Dental Veneers in Casablanca | Dr Myriam Lahlou
facettes-dentaires-casablanca.metaDescription: Dental veneers in Casablanca by Dr Myriam Lahlou. Natural, long-lasting veneers for a radiant smile. Book your appointment.
facettes-dentaires-casablanca.heroSubtitle: Redesign your smile with custom-made veneers — natural and long-lasting.
introParagraphs: Dental veneers are ultra-thin shells of ceramic or composite bonded to the front of the teeth to modify their shape, shade or alignment. They permanently correct smile imperfections — stained, chipped, slightly misaligned or small teeth — without heavy treatment.

Dr Myriam Lahlou designs each veneer fully customised, taking into account the facial features, the shade of natural teeth and the patient's aesthetic goals. The aim: a harmonious, brilliant and completely natural smile.
The treatment is completed in 2 to 3 appointments: a preparatory and impression visit, then the definitive bonding of the veneers with careful control of the bite and symmetry.
facettes-dentaires-casablanca.whoFor: This treatment is ideal for people who want to improve the aesthetics of their smile without heavy preparation. It suits healthy teeth, free of cavities and gum disease.

steps.title: Initial consultation
steps.text: Dr Lahlou analyses your smile, takes photos and digital impressions to design the ideal veneers.

steps.title: Impression & simulation
steps.text: A digital mock-up shows you the final result before bonding, to validate the shape and shade you want.

steps.title: Tooth preparation
steps.text: A micro-layer (about 0.5 mm) is removed from the tooth surface to seat the veneers without excess bulk.

steps.title: Definitive bonding
steps.text: The veneers are bonded with high-adhesion composite. Dr Lahlou fine-tunes the bite and symmetry for a perfect result.

steps.title: Check-up & follow-up
steps.text: A review appointment is scheduled a few days after bonding to verify comfort and smile harmony.

benefits: Natural smile: veneers perfectly mimic natural enamel
Shade correction: eliminates stains and yellow discolouration
Long-lasting: 10 to 15 years with good oral hygiene
Gentle preparation: minimal enamel removal
Immediate result: the smile changes from the day of bonding

faq.q: Do veneers damage natural teeth?
faq.a: No, preparation only removes a very thin layer of enamel (0.3 to 0.5 mm). Teeth remain healthy and well protected.

faq.q: What is the cost of dental veneers in Casablanca?
faq.a: The cost depends on the number of veneers and the material chosen (ceramic or composite). A quote is provided at the first visit.

faq.q: How long do veneers last?
faq.a: Ceramic veneers last on average 10 to 15 years. Composite veneers last 5 to 8 years.

faq.q: Can I eat normally with veneers?
faq.a: Yes, veneers withstand normal biting forces. However, biting hard objects (nuts, ice) directly with veneered teeth is not recommended.

implants-dentaires-casablanca.metaTitle: Dental Implants in Casablanca | Dr Myriam Lahlou
implants-dentaires-casablanca.metaDescription: Dental implants in Casablanca by Dr Myriam Lahlou. Permanent, natural replacement of missing teeth. Book your appointment.
implants-dentaires-casablanca.heroSubtitle: Replace missing teeth with titanium implants for a complete, natural smile.
introParagraphs: A dental implant is an artificial titanium root, surgically placed in the jawbone, onto which a definitive crown or bridge is fixed. It is the most reliable and durable solution for replacing one or more missing teeth.

Dr Myriam Lahlou masters modern implantology techniques: immediate-load placement, bone grafting when needed, and personalised post-operative follow-up. Every implant is planned in 3D for maximum precision.
With implants, you regain full chewing function without altering neighbouring teeth, and oral comfort comparable to natural teeth.
implants-dentaires-casablanca.whoFor: Implants suit adults in good oral health with sufficient jawbone. Bone grafting may be offered if the bone is insufficient.

steps.title: Assessment & imaging
steps.text: A complete work-up including a 3D scan (CBCT) evaluates bone density and plans the implant placement.

steps.title: Implant placement
steps.text: The titanium implant is inserted into the bone under local anaesthesia. The procedure lasts 30 to 60 minutes.

steps.title: Osseointegration
steps.text: Over 3 to 6 months, the bone naturally fuses around the implant. A provisional crown can be worn during this period.

steps.title: Definitive crown
steps.text: An impression is taken, then the definitive ceramic crown is fixed onto the implant.

steps.title: Long-term follow-up
steps.text: Regular check-ups monitor the condition of the implant and gums.

benefits: Permanent solution: implants can last a lifetime with proper care
Natural appearance: custom crowns indistinguishable from natural teeth
Bone preservation: stimulates the jawbone
Neighbouring teeth untouched: healthy teeth are not altered
Comfort like natural teeth: normal chewing and speech

faq.q: Is dental implant placement painful?
faq.a: Placement is done under local anaesthesia. Most patients describe minimal discomfort, similar to tooth extraction.

faq.q: How long does the full treatment take?
faq.a: The complete treatment lasts 4 to 8 months, including the osseointegration period (3 to 6 months).

faq.q: Are implants suitable for smokers?
faq.a: Smokers have a slightly higher risk of implant failure. Reducing tobacco before and after surgery is recommended.

faq.q: Can several implants be placed in one session?
faq.a: Yes, multiple placements are possible in a single session. A personalised treatment plan is established at the first visit.

esthetique-dentaire-casablanca.metaTitle: Aesthetic Dentistry in Casablanca | Dr Myriam Lahlou
esthetique-dentaire-casablanca.metaDescription: Aesthetic dentistry in Casablanca by Dr Myriam Lahlou. Harmonious smile, brilliant shade, durable results. Book your appointment.
esthetique-dentaire-casablanca.heroSubtitle: Enhance your smile with personalised, high-performance aesthetic treatments.
introParagraphs: Aesthetic dentistry covers all treatments that improve the appearance of the smile: whitening, harmonisation, bonding, adjustments of tooth shape and shade. The goal is a natural, brilliant result in perfect keeping with the facial features.
Dr Myriam Lahlou combines clinical expertise and artistic sensitivity to offer tailor-made aesthetic solutions for each patient. Results are visible from the very first sessions.
Whether you want to whiten your teeth, correct a slight asymmetry or harmonise your whole smile, a personalised treatment plan is proposed.
esthetique-dentaire-casablanca.whoFor: Anyone in good oral health wishing to improve their smile — dull, stained, slightly asymmetrical or gapped teeth.

steps.title: Smile analysis
steps.text: Photographs, impressions and examination of the gums and teeth define the aesthetic goals.

steps.title: Treatment plan
steps.text: Dr Lahlou presents the suitable options: whitening, composite, veneers, or a combination of techniques.

steps.title: Whitening session
steps.text: For dull shades, chairside whitening is completed in about 1 to 2 hours with full gum protection.

steps.title: Bonding & adjustments
steps.text: Minor defects (thickness, shape, spacing) are corrected with composite for a natural look.

steps.title: Final photo & follow-up
steps.text: Comparison photos confirm the result. A maintenance product is provided to keep the shine.

benefits: Brilliant smile: white, natural and harmonious shade
Quick results: visible changes from the first session
Non-invasive treatment: maximum preservation of natural teeth
Combinable solutions: whitening + composite + veneers to fit your needs
Positive psychological effect: reinforced self-confidence

faq.q: Is teeth whitening harmful?
faq.a: No, when performed under medical supervision whitening is safe and does not damage enamel. Dr Lahlou uses professional-grade products.

faq.q: How long does whitening last?
faq.a: Results last 1 to 2 years on average, depending on your habits (tobacco, coffee, tea). Periodical top-ups maintain the shine.

faq.q: Can whitening and veneers be combined?
faq.a: Yes, in some cases whitening is done before veneers to define the ideal shade.

faq.q: Is composite strong enough?
faq.a: Yes, modern composites offer excellent resistance to staining and wear, with great aesthetic results.

orthodontie-casablanca.metaTitle: Orthodontics in Casablanca | Dr Myriam Lahlou
orthodontie-casablanca.metaDescription: Orthodontics in Casablanca by Dr Myriam Lahlou. Discreet, effective alignment for a harmonious smile. Book your appointment.
orthodontie-casablanca.heroSubtitle: Correct tooth alignment with discreet, tailor-made solutions.
introParagraphs: Orthodontics corrects tooth misalignment, bite problems and unwanted gaps, for a harmonious and functional smile. It concerns both children and adults.
Dr Myriam Lahlou offers modern, discreet solutions: clear aligners (Invisalign-type), ceramic braces and techniques adapted to each case, with regular follow-up.
Beyond aesthetics, orthodontics improves oral health by making brushing easier, reducing cavity risk and relieving jaw joint tension.
orthodontie-casablanca.whoFor: Anyone with tooth misalignment, malocclusion or gaps between teeth, regardless of age. Adults now represent a large share of orthodontic patients.

steps.title: Orthodontic assessment
steps.text: Imaging and 3D modelling analyse the position of the teeth and the dental arch.

steps.title: Choosing the appliance
steps.text: Clear aligners, ceramic braces or a combination, depending on the case and the patient's preferences.

steps.title: Setup
steps.text: Aligners are made to measure and worn 20 to 22 hours a day. Changed every two weeks.

steps.title: Regular follow-up
steps.text: Review appointments every 6 to 8 weeks fine-tune the treatment.

steps.title: Retention
steps.text: After treatment, a retainer (bonded wire or tray) permanently maintains the results.

benefits: Precise alignment: clear aligners correct misalignments with accuracy
Discreetness: ceramic braces and aligners are virtually invisible
Comfort: no visible wires, simple and fast adjustments
Oral health: easier brushing after treatment
Stable results: permanent retention after treatment

faq.q: Is orthodontics possible at any age?
faq.a: Yes, orthodontics suits both adults and children. Adult bone moves more slowly but results are just as satisfactory.

faq.q: How long does orthodontic treatment take?
faq.a: Duration varies from 6 to 24 months depending on case complexity. Dr Lahlou establishes a precise timeline at the initial assessment.

faq.q: Are clear aligners really invisible?
faq.a: Almost invisible, yes. In normal conversation they go unnoticed — the ideal solution for adults seeking maximum discreetness.

faq.q: Do I need a retainer after treatment?
faq.a: Yes, to stabilise long-term results. A bonded wire behind the teeth or a night tray is usually recommended.

traitement-canalaire-casablanca.metaTitle: Root Canal Treatment in Casablanca | Dr Myriam Lahlou
traitement-canalaire-casablanca.metaDescription: Painless root canal treatment in Casablanca by Dr Myriam Lahlou. Save your infected tooth with precision care. Book your appointment.
traitement-canalaire-casablanca.heroSubtitle: Save your infected tooth with precise, painless root canal care.
introParagraphs: Root canal treatment (endodontics) removes the infected dental pulp (the nerve), then cleans, disinfects and seals the root canals. It saves a tooth that would otherwise be lost.
Dr Myriam Lahlou performs root canal treatments under a microscope, with modern techniques ensuring great precision. The procedure is done under local anaesthesia, in optimal comfort.
After treatment, the tooth is covered with a crown to restore its strength. The result is durable and the pain generally disappears within the first 24 hours.
traitement-canalaire-casablanca.whoFor: Root canal treatment is needed for deep cavities, dental fractures or trauma that have infected the pulp. It is indicated when the tooth is still recoverable.

steps.title: Diagnosis & imaging
steps.text: An X-ray or scan evaluates the extent of infection and the shape of the canals.

steps.title: Anaesthesia & access
steps.text: Under local anaesthesia, a small opening is made in the tooth to reach the pulp.

steps.title: Canal cleaning
steps.text: The canals are enlarged, cleaned and disinfected with precision instruments under a microscope.

steps.title: Sealing
steps.text: The canals are sealed with a biocompatible material to prevent re-infection.

steps.title: Final restoration
steps.text: The tooth is covered with a crown to restore strength and aesthetics.

benefits: Painless: the procedure is done under local anaesthesia, without pain
Precision: operating microscope for optimal cleaning
Tooth saving: avoids extraction and implant replacement
Quick relief: pain disappears within 24 to 48 hours
Durability: the crown protects the restored tooth for years

faq.q: Is root canal treatment painful?
faq.a: No, it is performed under local anaesthesia and is completely painless. Most patients feel no pain during the procedure.

faq.q: How many visits are needed?
faq.a: Most root canals are completed in a single session of about 45 to 60 minutes.

faq.q: Does the tooth remain alive after treatment?
faq.a: No, the pulp is removed. However, the tooth remains functional and anchored in the bone, protected by a crown.

faq.q: What if pain persists after treatment?
faq.a: Minor discomfort is normal for 2 to 3 days. If pain continues beyond that, a prompt check-up is needed.

composite-casablanca.metaTitle: Composite Restoration in Casablanca | Dr Myriam Lahlou
composite-casablanca.metaDescription: Aesthetic composite restoration in Casablanca by Dr Myriam Lahlou. Invisible, natural repair of damaged teeth. Book your appointment.
composite-casablanca.heroSubtitle: Repair damaged teeth with invisible, aesthetic composite restorations.
introParagraphs: Dental composite is an aesthetic restorative material, shaded to match the natural tooth. It repairs cavities, fractures, chips and gaps with a completely invisible result.
Dr Myriam Lahlou masters layered stratification, an advanced protocol that applies the composite in successive layers to faithfully reproduce the nuances and translucency of natural enamel.
Composite is applied in a single session, with no impression or laboratory work. It is a fast, cost-effective and aesthetically strong solution for front and back teeth.
composite-casablanca.whoFor: Composite suits cavities, fractures, chips, diastemas (gaps) and minor aesthetic changes. It is an alternative to veneers for simple corrections.

steps.title: Preparation
steps.text: The damaged area is cleaned and prepared. If a cavity is present, it is removed under local anaesthesia.

steps.title: Shade selection
steps.text: Dr Lahlou precisely selects the composite shade to match the natural tooth.

steps.title: Layered stratification
steps.text: The composite is applied layer by layer, each cured with light for strength and aesthetics.

steps.title: Final polishing
steps.text: The restoration is polished to a natural shine and smooth feel, indistinguishable from the tooth.

steps.title: Bite check
steps.text: Dr Lahlou verifies that chewing works correctly without overloading the restoration.

benefits: Invisible result: shade perfectly matched to the natural tooth
Speed: treatment completed in a single session
Tooth preservation: minimal preparation
Immediate aesthetic result: the tooth regains its natural shape
Affordable: economical alternative to veneers

faq.q: Does composite stain over time?
faq.a: Modern composite resists staining well. With good hygiene, it keeps its shine for 5 to 8 years.

faq.q: How long does a composite restoration last?
faq.a: On average 5 to 8 years, depending on location, chewing load and patient habits.

faq.q: Is composite as strong as a crown?
faq.a: For small and medium restorations, yes. For heavily damaged teeth, a crown may be preferable.

faq.q: Can composite be placed on an already restored tooth?
faq.a: Yes, an old composite can be replaced or repaired. Dr Lahlou assesses the best option at the visit.
